entities.summary: Pedro Teixeira, occasionally referred to as the Conqueror of the Amazon, was a Portuguese conquistador and military officer. In 1637, he became the first European to travel up and down the entire length of the Amazon River, while also heading the government of the captaincy of Pará in two different periods, one in 1620-1621 and another in 1640–1641.
